title: L'Arsène's Ludicrous Larceny — DM Companion (Maps)
description: Unofficial supplemental battlemaps for the free adventure L'Arsène's Ludicrous Larceny by Humperdink's Wares & Loot Tavern: a realistic water-temple map and the modular Lemnisciator infinity-loop tileset, delivered as a Foundry Scenes compendium. Contains original AI-generated map art only; the original adventure and its Foundry module are linked in the README.
